import XCTest
import Testing

final class SkipTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSkipIf() throws {
        try XCTSkipIf(ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["CI"] != nil)
    }

    func testSkipUnless() throws {
        try XCTSkipUnless(FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: "x"))
    }

    func testThrow() throws {
        if isCI { throw XCTSkip("CI") }
    }
}

struct SkipSuite {
    @Test(.enabled(if: hasNetwork)) func online() {}
    @Test(.disabled(if: isCI)) func offline() {}
}
